label: Media Video Gen
summary: Optional-tier video generation soft template with honest setup tips.
description: Media pack. Reports that video generation is optional and not fully available by default. media.video.generate never pretends success without a configured provider API. Soft-try only when VIDEO_GEN_API_KEY (or documented provider keys) are present; otherwise returns setup tips.
